voice.title: Your voice
voice.intro: Read one short passage aloud. Lingard then plays Accent studio lines in your own voice, with a native accent, so you hear exactly how you could sound.
voice.readHint: Tap record, read the whole passage at your own pace (at least {{min}} seconds), then tap stop. Mistakes and accent don't matter: only the sound of your voice is kept.
voice.consentNeeded: Turn on the permission above to record.
voice.readyHint: Accent studio now plays each line in your voice, with a native accent.
voice.deleteHint: Deleting removes the clone and your recording everywhere, including at our voice provider.
